rows.label: Weakened Medjay Predasite
rows.note: capture only after Infested damage it

conditions: A healthy capture gives only Medjay Predasite Tags, which are Conservation currency and cannot build the companion.
Your own damage never weakens it; only roaming Infested do. Predasites need two tranq darts.
Predasites resist Warframe abilities by 75%, and the resistance stacks with repeated use until they are immune.
bonuses: Tags from extra captures trade to Son for the Son Tokens gilding needs.

disclosures.title: getting the Weakened hit
disclosures.body: Tranq it first, then bring Infested to the sleeping animal and go invisible so aggro switches to it. A Pherliac Pod dropped on it pulls Infested in, and Loki's Switch Teleport can move it into a group. Hunt on foot, not in Archwing, where Infested tend to ignore the target.

groups.activity: revivify, level to 30, gild, level to 30 again
groups.meta: 5,000 cr now; 10 Son Tokens and 5,000 standing to gild
conditions: Only a gilded Medjay earns Mastery; gilding resets it to rank 0, so level it to 30 twice.
Once one gilded Medjay hits rank 30, another build gives no more Mastery.
Its Medjay Claws level but give no Mastery.
bonuses: Son Tokens also come from tag trades, pickups on the Drift and Grandmother's Mend the Family trade.
